milestones.title: A connected world of regions
milestones.summary: Several persistent worlds run side by side as one group: Gaia (the mainland), the Rail Yard, Mars and the Moon. Every character has one home world, starts on Gaia and travels to the others in seconds, carrying food, tools and supplies. Sleeping regions wake when a traveller sets off. An Orbit region for space stations follows.
milestones.availability_note: Region groups, travel, home worlds, Mars and the Moon are merged. The Orbit world is built and goes live next. Travel between groups on different machines is a separate goal below.

evidence.label: Run regions as a group on one host
The Moon as its own world

completion.basis: Maintainer roadmap review on 2026-11-07 accepted the merged implementation as this milestone's scope.

milestones.title: Server updates without a long outage
milestones.summary: A new build is staged beside a running region, loads its save as a standby and takes over while the old world keeps playing. Each region updates in turn, and a failed handover rolls back so play continues on the old build.
milestones.availability_note: Staged handover and its port fixes are merged and can be driven from the launcher. A region's first update onto this build is still an ordinary restart.

evidence.label: Hand a running region over to its staged build
Staged handover ports and launcher view

completion.basis: Maintainer roadmap review on 2026-11-07 accepted the merged implementation as this milestone's scope.

milestones.title: An optional desktop launcher
milestones.summary: The optional Civ13 launcher finds servers, wakes sleeping ones and joins them, and gives hosts a Host tab for every region: start, stop, sleep, wake, save, update with a staged build, advance the shared epoch and run Player help. Direct BYOND joining stays supported.
milestones.availability_note: Per-region host actions, staged updates and epoch control are merged and published in the launcher. New server-management features keep landing in the launcher as they merge.

evidence.label: Save, update and restart each region
One-region host actions and group status

completion.basis: Maintainer roadmap review on 2026-11-07 accepted the merged implementation as this milestone's scope.

milestones.title: Optional Discord sign-in
milestones.summary: Sign in through the launcher with a Discord account so your character can follow your account rather than one BYOND key. Discord stays optional; playing with a BYOND key alone works as before.
milestones.availability_note: Account keys, single-use join tickets and launcher sign-in are merged, and sign-in is on by default in the launcher.

evidence.label: Discord account keys and join tickets

completion.basis: Maintainer roadmap review on 2026-11-07 accepted the merged implementation as this milestone's scope.

milestones.title: Rockets and space stations in orbit
milestones.summary: Launch into orbit from 1969 with two-stage rockets and capsules, work outside on EVA with handholds and safety tethers, and build a starter station through a launch complex project. Next comes the 2013 stage: modular pods that dock, extra decks and station upkeep, then reusable rockets and wider station networks from 2026.
milestones.availability_note: Stage B is merged: orbital flight, EVA, station hardware, starter stations and Moon sortie gear. Stage C (modular docking stations) is next, and the Orbit region still has to go live.

milestones.title: Settlements on Mars and the Moon
milestones.summary: Survey other worlds with probes, fly crewed landers, build pressurised habitats with life support, explore in pressure suits, mine ice and regolith, drive sealed rovers and grow self-sufficient bases with a propellant plant and flights home. The Moon opens from 1969 and Mars from 2026.
milestones.availability_note: All six settlement phases are merged, from survey probes to closed-loop bases and return flights.

evidence.label: Closed loops, propellant plant and flights home

completion.basis: Maintainer roadmap review on 2026-11-07 accepted the merged implementation as this milestone's scope.

milestones.title: Aircraft that take off and land
milestones.summary: Build aircraft from parts, taxi down runways and fly over the map, seeing the ground below and casting a shadow. Next: hangars and research so players can build planes, then free-form parts, helicopters and jets, and later air routes, parachutes and weapons.
milestones.availability_note: The flight core and the view from the air are merged; planes are admin-spawned for testing. Hangars and research, which make aircraft available to players, are the next phase.

evidence.label: Ground view, shadows and in-flight saves

milestones.title: Industrialization: factories, pipes and foundries
milestones.summary: Run automated factories with belts, feeder and sorting arms, fabricators and a factory monitor; move liquids through pipe networks with pumps, tanks and reaction vessels; and pour molten metal straight into tools at a casting foundry. Steam-era belts open earlier, and factory arms can load vehicle cargo holds.
milestones.availability_note: Factory automation, chemistry pipelines and the casting foundry are merged. A balance pass on player-built production lines comes later.

completion.basis: Maintainer roadmap review on 2026-11-07 accepted the merged implementation as this milestone's scope.

milestones.title: Metalworking benches and electroplating
milestones.summary: Dedicated weapon, fletching and toolsmith's benches turn materials straight into finished items, and an electroplating bath coats metal objects. More plating metals can follow once those metals exist in the game.
milestones.availability_note: The dedicated benches and the electroplating bath are merged.

completion.basis: Maintainer roadmap review on 2026-11-07 accepted the merged implementation as this milestone's scope.

milestones.title: Map tools for builders
milestones.summary: byond-devtools reads Civ13 maps, renders them as stored or as they look in game with lighting, makes safe copy-on-write edits and previews maps in VS Code. Next: a visual map editor and AI-assisted editing.
milestones.availability_note: The tool foundation is merged in the byond-devtools repository. The visual editor and AI-assisted editing are the next stage.

completion.basis: Maintainer roadmap review on 2026-11-07 accepted the merged implementation as this milestone's scope.

milestones.title: A train home for your party
milestones.summary: Build your party's first train as a project at a railway station whose track runs to the map edge. The finished train waits in its own berth in the Rail Yard world, with party-only doors that raiders can force only while a member is online.
milestones.availability_note: Railway works offices, the Rail Yard world and its berths are merged.

evidence.label: Build a train at a railway station
Rail Yard world with party berths

completion.basis: Maintainer roadmap review on 2026-11-07 accepted the merged implementation as this milestone's scope.

milestones.title: The 2026 Digital Age
milestones.summary: A new age after the Modern Age with smartphones, drones, lithium-ion batteries, LED panels, 3D printers and a smart hub that takes voice commands for lights, plugs and locks.
milestones.availability_note: The Digital Age and its first devices are merged.

completion.basis: Maintainer roadmap review on 2026-11-07 accepted the merged implementation as this milestone's scope.

milestones.title: Raiders, traders and reputation
milestones.summary: Nomad settlements meet NPC raiding parties and trader caravans, and build a reputation with the groups they deal with.
milestones.availability_note: Raids, caravans and reputation are merged.

completion.basis: Maintainer roadmap review on 2026-11-07 accepted the merged implementation as this milestone's scope.

milestones.title: Wildlife by habitat
milestones.summary: Animals spawn across the whole map according to their habitat instead of fixed spawners that refill on every restart.
milestones.availability_note: Habitat-based wildlife spawning is merged for Nomads maps.

evidence.label: Wildlife by habitat across the map

completion.basis: Maintainer roadmap review on 2026-11-07 accepted the merged implementation as this milestone's scope.

milestones.title: Generated surface, island and cavern worlds
milestones.summary: Generate reproducible surface, ocean-island, cavern and airless worlds from a seed and turn them into playable region maps with resources, wildlife, elevation and climate.
milestones.availability_note: The generators and playable region maps are merged; Mars and the Moon are built this way.

completion.basis: Maintainer roadmap review on 2026-11-07 accepted the merged implementation as this milestone's scope.

milestones.title: Smoother saves for persistent worlds
milestones.summary: Save the world quickly while it keeps running, recover safely after an interrupted save and check the result outside the game so validation never stalls play.
milestones.availability_note: The stream saver, interrupted-save recovery and faster large saves are merged; a full save now takes minutes instead of about twenty. Moving validation into an outside process is the next step.

milestones.title: Extraction survival
milestones.summary: Explore dangerous areas, collect loot and return to a persistent safehouse. Raid worlds such as the Crossroads Mall and the zombie city send persistent characters out and bring them home. Planned for in-game eras from 1943 onward.
milestones.availability_note: Safe houses, the mall raid and raid worlds are merged. Combined persistence, transport and recovery acceptance on a real run remains.

milestones.title: Geography, elevation and weather-driven snow
milestones.summary: Keep biome, elevation and shelter independent, make hills and mountains colder, and let snowfall build ground cover that melts or can be shovelled away without replacing the soil underneath.
milestones.availability_note: Elevation metadata, colder high ground on generated maps and weather-driven snow are merged. Hand-made maps opting in and a real-client snow check remain.

milestones.title: Persistent world editing and map authoring
milestones.summary: Keep zones and spawn points stable through saves and export a saved world back into Civ13 map source for mappers.
milestones.availability_note: Zone persistence and whole-world map export are merged. A visual editor built on byond-devtools and a mapper guide are planned.

evidence.label: Export the whole world as a map

milestones.title: Smooth movement
milestones.summary: Smooth walking, diagonal moves, prone crawling, vendor NPCs and pulling crates and stacks, without changing movement speed or costs.
milestones.availability_note: Player, crawl, vendor and pulling movement are merged and on by default. Smooth wildlife movement remains disabled until its timing is fixed.

milestones.title: Authoritative line of sight
milestones.summary: Walls, doors and openings block what each player can see, applied to hover, examine, targeting and agent observations while the HUD stays visible.
milestones.availability_note: Geometric line of sight, wall faces and opacity refresh are merged. Gameplay adapters, hidden-information protection and cost measurements remain.

milestones.title: Lighting for oversized sprites
milestones.summary: Light large trees, shadows and other artwork that extends beyond its tile, without changing ordinary light propagation.
milestones.availability_note: A disabled composition prototype is merged. Rendering issues and a connected-client check remain.

milestones.title: Liminal Facility escape mode
milestones.summary: A finite escape round through authored rooms, set in 1990, with a threat to avoid, steady lamps and indoor sound.
milestones.availability_note: Room layouts, map export, the escape round and the threat, light and sound pass are merged. Playtesting with real players remains.

milestones.title: Powered-gateway expeditions
milestones.summary: Power a gateway, survey authored rooms with finite supplies and found a persistent colony on the other side.
milestones.availability_note: The design and a disabled power-state foundation are merged. Physical gateways, supplies, rescue and paired-world saves remain.

milestones.title: Diet, preferences and food discovery
milestones.summary: Balanced meals build nutrient reserves and energy, characters learn hidden tastes, and varied recipes pay off.
milestones.availability_note: Balanced diet and hidden tastes are merged. Penalties stay off until every map has enough food variety.

milestones.title: Discord presence, friends and invites
milestones.summary: Show what you are playing on Discord through the launcher, with friends lists, invitations and joining to follow.
milestones.availability_note: Discord activity through the launcher is merged. Friends, invitations and joining are planned.

milestones.title: Player-built crossings and routes
milestones.summary: Players build trail markers that open to another region once an admin approves them, and later ferries and rail routes between regions.
milestones.availability_note: Admin-approved trail markers are merged. Player-made ferries and rail routes between regions are planned.

milestones.title: Travel between servers on different machines
milestones.summary: Extend region travel so characters can move between region groups hosted on different machines, with the same single-owner custody and recovery rules.
milestones.availability_note: Travel works within one host's region group. Groups spanning machines need design and testing.

milestones.title: Ocean voyages, offshore rigs and submarines
milestones.summary: Sail between ocean maps, build and maintain offshore oil rigs, and build submarines and underwater habitats with pressure, air and power.
milestones.availability_note: Ocean bridges, boats and a shared air ledger for submarine compartments are groundwork. Routes, depth and the vessels themselves need design.

milestones.title: Recovery when a region goes offline
milestones.summary: Let a player recover their character and belongings into another live region after a shutdown or outage, without duplicating anything.
milestones.availability_note: The home ledger records which region owns each player. Fenced ownership of goods and a recovery path remain.
